author: daveDash
quote:
Apparently metacritic update reviews to a more positive score after user submmision. You can find reviews that are scored 10-8, and they have a fairly negative opinion about the game. It should have even a lower rating..

Honestly, the game is a dissapoitment. Low fps. Quite a few of bugs that had interrupted my gameplay. And in general it is quite boring compared to gta 5.  You can't even steal some of the cars. Gameplay feels slow.
